records.name: Hernand
records.summary: The green, forested starting region, home to the City of Hernand and most of Pywel's noble houses.
records.body: Hernand is the first region Kliff explores after the prologue in Pailune and the game's main hub. It is the best documented region and holds the largest share of faction questlines, from [[faction:greymanes]] allies to the noble houses that feud over its estates.

sources.title: Crimson Desert map: full region map, cities and more

records.name: Pailune
records.summary: The cold, mountainous north where the Greymanes made their camp and where the story's opening attack takes place.

sources.title: Crimson Desert map: full region map, cities and more

records.name: Demeniss
records.summary: Pywel's political and religious centre, with castles and temples under House Caliburn's influence.

sources.title: Crimson Desert map: full region map, cities and more

records.name: Delesyia
records.summary: A trade-driven region with an active criminal underworld; descriptions of its technology vary between sources.

sources.title: Crimson Desert map: full region map, cities and more

records.name: Crimson Desert
records.summary: The lawless red-sand desert with no central government; Tommaso, Varnia, Urdavah and Arcosa are its named settlements.

sources.title: Crimson Desert map: full region map, cities and more

records.name: The Abyss
records.summary: A separate layer above Pywel with floating islands, its own fast-travel nodes and Abyss-tier gear and bosses.
records.body: The Abyss is described as a layer above Pywel rather than a ground region; the details here are inferred from map data and secondary sources, not checked in-game. th.gl maps it as a second tile pyramid; the companion will add it later (docs/COMPANION-SPEC.md section 9). Records that live there use `map: "abyss"` in their location.
